annotation.title_clean: Statement by Germany to the minutes on the Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: Statement by Germany to the minutes on the Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of the Federal Republic of Germany; Council of the EU (Permanent Representatives Committee)
annotation.venue: Council of the EU document register (ST 14954 2022 ADD 1)
annotation.summary_en: Council of the EU note transmitting a German statement to the minutes on the AI Act. Germany supports the Presidency's text for the 6 December 2022 general approach but sees need for improvements, referring to its written comments of 8 November 2022, and asks that they be considered in trilogue negotiations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Germany supports the Presidency text for the general approach at the Telecommunications Council on 6 December 2022
Germany sees need for improvements on certain aspects, referring to its written comments of 8 November 2022
Asks that these aspects be considered in interinstitutional negotiations with the Commission and Parliament
